The edge block has two orientations; the three-vertex block has one. The block multiplicities are forced to be 2n−3k and 2k−n. Marking the beginning of a block on a cycle in a fixed cyclic direction gives n possible starting vertices and n−k marks per configuration, including periodic patterns and the three choices of center for a single block on C_3. This proves both spectra, their endpoints and the two generating functions. The dominant root λ(e^u) of λ³−2e^uλ−e^{2u}=0 has a uniform modulus gap near u=0. The characteristic-function limit follows from the gap and the Taylor expansion.
